provenance.purpose: Stage 0 of the 3B backbone lineage. Exact port of the 1.5B config configs/cls_secure_code_primevul_qwen15bcoder_lora_pair_diff_only_3000_v1.json (recovered from commit 06da8a2^, pruned in 06da8a2) with the backbone swapped.
provenance.DEVIATION_precision: The 1.5B stage 0 ran in fp32. A 3B in fp32 is 12.4 GB of weights alone and does not fit a 12 GB card, so this run is bf16 with gradient checkpointing. Every downstream stage in the 1.5B lineage already ran bf16 + gradient checkpointing, so this makes stage 0 consistent with the rest of the chain rather than introducing a new regime.
provenance.DEVIATION_save_steps: save_steps 100 -> 200; intermediate checkpoints are not used by any downstream stage, this only halves the write volume.
